job.title: Software Engineer, Partner Engineering
job.description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.
responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain partner integration solutions
Translate partner requirements into scalable technical implementations
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve tools and ensure successful partner onboarding and launches
Build deep technical expertise in Liftoff products to maximize customer impact
Drive successful client outcomes by translating complex business requirements into high-impact, scalable technical solutions
Own the end-to-end technical lifecycle for partner integrations
Innovate by refining Liftoff’s tools and products based on direct customer and partner feedback
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve reported issues
Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless and consistent partner experiences
Foster engineering excellence through design, risk-driven testing, and code review
